headline: Jerry Moriarty, Painter Whose Brushstrokes Elevated Comics, Is Dead at 88
context: A self-described “paintoonist,” Mr. Moriarty created cartoons with spare dialogue that reminded his admirers of poetry or Samuel Beckett’s plays.
